articles.title: Canadian home sales edged up in October amid overall flat housing market: CREA
articles.summary: Home sales across Canada edged up slightly in October — defying the expectations of some analysts — but remained below levels from October 2025, according to the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA).

articles.title: Hooked by design: How gambling apps keep 'losers' spending more cash
articles.summary: A CBC News investigation has found online gamblers are targets of a sophisticated, multibillion-dollar industry that routinely uses automated inducements and app design features that try to keep heavy users hooked.

articles.title: Canada and China announce new trade measures and cultural partnerships on Carney's 1st day in Shenzhen
